inventory_scope: Reviewed official sources concerning Liechtenstein residence and free movement, related procedure and remedies, and official operational guidance. EEA, Swiss, and third-country legal routes remain distinct.

entries.title: Personenfreizügigkeitsgesetz (PFZG), LR 152.21
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex current-text frame version 11; consolidation as of 1 January 2026; latest listed amendment LGBl 2025.397, effective 1 January 2026
entries.scope: Primary law governing entry, residence and family reunification for EEA/Swiss nationals and specified family/other-beneficiary categories, with a Liechtenstein-specific EEA solution and quota structure.
limitations: Lilex says consolidated laws are informational and have no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country review completion.
Dependencies and treaty bases require separate review; no legal equivalence with other EEA or EU national regimes is implied.

entries.title: Personenfreizügigkeitsverordnung (PFZV), LR 152.211
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex text-frame version 15; consolidation 1 January 2024; latest listed amendments LGBl 2023.458 and 2023.464, both effective 1 January 2024
entries.scope: Implementing regulation under PFZG concerning entry, residence, permits, evidence, family reunification, and related procedure for the EEA/Swiss free-movement framework in Liechtenstein.
limitations: Lilex says consolidated laws and regulations are informational and have no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
PFZV implements PFZG; EEA instruments, the special Liechtenstein EEA solution, and the Swiss framework remain separate dependencies.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country review completion.
Raw response files were unavailable for offline replay in the current checkout; official HTML/PDF anchors were checked and the limitation is recorded.

entries.title: Ausländergesetz (AuG), LR 152.20
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex text-frame version 25; consolidation dated 12 June 2026; latest listed amendment LGBl 2026.143, effective 12 June 2026
entries.scope: Entry, residence, family reunification, integration, and related procedure for persons within AuG Art. 2, principally third-country nationals and family members of persons within that scope; EEA/Swiss routes remain distinct.
limitations: Lilex consolidated laws are informational and have no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
AuG Art. 2 sets personal-scope limits and excludes the PFZG free-movement route.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country review completion.
Current procedure, forms, and related legal dependencies require separate review.

entries.title: Verordnung über die Zulassung und den Aufenthalt von Ausländern (ZAV), LR 152.201
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex current-text frame version 17; latest listed amendment LGBl 2026.193, effective 12 June 2026
entries.scope: Implementing regulation under AuG covering detailed admission, residence, permits, family reunification, screening and related procedure, including specific cross-border-service rules; the PFZG EEA/Swiss residence route remains distinct.
limitations: Lilex consolidations are informational and have no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
The version reviewed includes LGBl 2026.193 effective 12 June 2026; later applicability is not established.
ZAV supplements the AuG third-country route and is not the PFZG EEA/Swiss regime.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country review completion.

entries.title: Verordnung über die Einreise und die Visumerteilung (VEV), LR 152.204
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex text-frame version 2; official PDF Fassung 12.10.2025; LGBl 2025.483 effective 12 October 2025; 2026 Systematisches Register stand 1 October lists LGBl 2025.483 as latest VEV amendment
entries.scope: Regulates entry into Liechtenstein and visa issuance, including short- and long-stay conditions, procedures, competent authorities, cooperation, refusal and remedies; applicable Schengen rules prevail where they differ, and Swiss/other representation agreements apply. Not a complete statement of Schengen law or current mission practice.
limitations: Lilex consolidated text is informational and has no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
The official system register is current to 1 October 2026; it does not exclude a later VEV change.
Schengen acquis, the Visa Code, Schengen Borders Code, VISV/EESV, AuG/PFZG, Swiss agreements, visa-fee rules and operational mission guidance require separate review.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country completion.
